sections.title: Unit 17: Information Overload, Rumor & Verification
body: In an era of relentless news cycles and digital echo chambers, distinguishing reliable reporting from unsubstantiated rumor has become an essential civic discipline. Hungarian journalistic tradition—from nineteenth-century press polemics to modern investigative reporting—has developed precise grammatical markers to calibrate the certainty of any claim.

In this unit, you will master Hungarian evidential framing. You will learn to signal reportative hearsay with úgy hírlik and állítólag, deduce likelihood with inferential markers such as a jelek szerint and alighanem, accurately attribute contested claims to their sources (állításuk szerint, elmondása alapján), and express measured epistemic caution when verifying disputed information.
